text:
maya (partnerships): Quick sync — we need to get AWS/GCP/Azure sandbox access + initial ingest ready for the upcoming marketplace listing. Main blockers: KMS setup, service account permissions, and trial SKU packaging. target: staging publish window end-of-month. cc @raj @lin @esme
raj (cloud): For clarity — which sandbox projects? aws-prod-sandbox? i recommend separate projects per cloud (aws-sbx, gcp-sbx, azure-sbx). I can create service accounts once we agree names. Also need confirmation on cross-account role for publisher ingestion.
lin (legal): Do we have the latest EULA/terms variant confirmed for EU customers? If telemetry is collected during trial we need to mark it. Also: Azure requires the publisher to attest AAD app consent; we should add that to the checklist.
esme (product): Packaging Qs: what SKU granularity are we doing for trial? 1) free tier (100k tokens) 2) paid trial (30d). Need exact numbers for the manifest and UI copy. Also we should localize the short description for en/fr/de.
oliver (ops): I can handle manifest ingest. Upload process is:
```
aws s3 cp ./marketplace-manifest.json s3://redwood-marketplace-ingest/
curl -X POST https://ingest.internal/api/v1/manifest -H "Authorization: Bearer $INGEST_TOKEN" -d @marketplace-manifest.json
```
I need the INGEST_TOKEN and the service account to be whitelisted.
maya (partnerships): Proposed names: svc-redwood-pub-aws@sandbox.redwood.com, svc-redwood-pub-gcp@project.iam.gserviceaccount.com, redwood-azure-app-registration. Raj — can you provision those and send creds to ops vault?
raj (cloud): Will do. For AWS KMS: do we want customer-managed key or Redwood-managed? If enterprise customers require CMEK, we should create a CMK in the sandbox now so we can test the flow.
lin (legal): If we plan to support CMEK for GA, add a note: contract addendum + KMS shared responsibility text. I'll draft the clause but need product sign-off on whether CMEK is mandatory or optional.
esme (product): Make CMEK optional for initial listing but documented. For trial customers we'll default to Redwood-managed keys and surface CMEK as an enterprise toggle.
maya (partnerships): Checklist with owners (rough):
- Service accounts + roles (raj)
- KMS sandbox keys (raj)
- Manifest + SKU mapping (esme + maya)
- Ingest pipeline + token (oliver)
- EULA / telemetry consent copy (lin)
- Localized short desc (esme)
Deadline: 7 days for initial sandbox readiness.
marketplace-bot: Sandbox provisioning request created: https://marketplace.internal/sbx/requests/8791 — status: pending (ops)
oliver (ops): I picked up request 8791, starting env spin-up now. Will post creds to vault when finished and ping here.
raj (cloud): FYI — granting pub ingestion role requires us to attach the following minimal policy for AWS: 
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:PutObject","s3:GetObject"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::redwood-marketplace-ingest/*"},
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-efgh"}
  ]
}
```
Confirm if that's okay for legal.
lin (legal): That policy looks fine for the sandbox as long as keys are test CMKs. Add TTL on tokens and rotate after ingest test.
esme (product): Small UX ask — can we include an 'About trial' blurb in the listing that calls out data handling and the optional CMEK toggle? I can draft copy if someone creates a content doc.
maya (partnerships): Perfect. Esme, drop draft in /shared/marketplace/docs and tag @lin. I'll update the timeline once ops reports back. :thumbsup:
